names.help0:
#e[To Enter the Event]#n

 If there's a notice posted #b#ein blue#n#k saying that we're accepting participants for an event, click on #e[Paul]#n and choose #e[Yeah, let's go!]#n to enter.
 If you have already clicked on [Paul] when the event starts, then just click on [Yeah, let's go!] to enter.

 Please read the event notice before entering.
 Once the event starts, participants will be accepted on a #efirst come, first serve#n basis until the event is full.

#eYou can't enter an event more than once within 24 hours.#n

 You won't be able to enter the event if you don't have any free slots available in your Etc. inventory to receive an Event Trophy, so make sure to leave a slot available.
 If you already have a #bSecret Scroll#k, please discard it before entering the event.

#r If you change channels or enter the #bCash Shop#k during the event, you'll automatically be disqualified from the event.
